decision.justification: Two independent views of this merchant disagree with its declaration. The storefront presents a different business, and the telemetry channel agrees. Neither could have produced the other: a merchant cannot change its payment behaviour without changing its actual business, and cannot change its interface without changing what customers see.

narrative.text: Merchant MID100014 declared subscription_box at onboarding 866 days ago. Telemetry dissents: the largest deviations from the subscription_box baseline are chargeback_drift at +3.7 sigma (observed 0.00732 against a category baseline of -8e-05), chargeback_rate at +3.7 sigma (observed 0.0122 against a category baseline of 0.00425), slope_log_volume at +3.4 sigma (observed 0.00835 against a category baseline of 0.00262). The checkout surface presents a crypto_exchange interface at 0.87 confidence, against a declared category of subscription_box. This vertical cannot be approved on this platform. Linked to 6 other merchants by rare shared asn, beneficiary id, device fp, ip block, payout fingerprint, phone fp, script bundle. Their payment behaviour is also moving in step (synchrony 0.81), which independent businesses do not do. It is linked to 6 other merchant accounts by rare shared asn, beneficiary id, device fp, ip block, payout fingerprint, phone fp, script bundle, and those accounts are moving in step (synchrony 0.81). A verification call was placed and produced no usable statement, which counts neither for nor against the merchant. In total 3 independent views of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 4 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because confidence threshold met. Recommended tier restricts settlements, corroborated by the telemetry channel; the storefront alone would not have been sufficient.
